obligations.title: Keep the other party's Confidential Information confidential and use it only for this Agreement, for 3 years after the Agreement ends.
Process personal data only on the Customer's documented instructions and in line with data protection law.
Execute a Data Processing Agreement before any personal data is processed.
Escalate disputes to senior management for resolution within 15 days, then go to mediation before court proceedings.
Do not solicit the other party's personnel involved in the services during the term and for 12 months afterwards.
